metadata.notes: Into Two Island's Joyful Game Corner: on its mat the owner's scene runs at once (pret TwoIsland_JoyfulGameCorner_EventScript_HelpFindLostelleScene, VAR_MAP_SCENE_TWO_ISLAND_JOYFUL_GAME_CORNER 0). Lostelle's father paces, comes down three tiles to (6, 8) and asks the player to find her; the player steps west to (4, 8); a Biker comes in on the door tile (5, 8), asks for Three Island and leaves. The scene sets VAR_MAP_SCENE_THREE_ISLAND 2, clears FLAG_HIDE_THREE_ISLAND_LONE_BIKER and sets the room's scene var to 1; none of them shows on a screen we read, and the Meteorite stays in the bag until Lostelle is home. The Biker is hidden from the new game (EventScript_ResetAllMapFlags) and shown only by the scene, so the walk out goes over the door tile (Frlg_overworld.Scene_only_people). Then back to the harbor and the Seagallop to Three Island, which lands at Three Island's harbor (8, 5); its port, north of the harbor, turns PC storage back on and holds the Bikers.

checkpoint.title: The Joyful Game Corner's owner asks for Lostelle; the Seagallop to Three Island

events.why: North through the door onto the Game Corner's mat (5, 8); the owner's scene starts there.
The owner's plea and the Biker's visit; the player ends a tile west of the mat, facing the owner.
Out over the door tile, west through town and down to the harbor, above the sailor (8, 6).
The sailor's list: THREE ISLAND (below ONE ISLAND), then the crossing to Three Island's harbor.
